notes.title: V0.2 Playtest - The Fate System Arrives!
notes.content:
⚔️ What Is the Fate System?[p align="start"]An auxiliary roguelike layer that tackles two core goals: 🎯 Deepen decision-making – more surprises, less repetition 🎯 Expand strategic skill expression – reward clever plays
[hr][/hr]🔮 How It Works
🃏 Fate Cards

New skills activated before combat by spending specific dice (e.g., one “6”)

Note: Only a portion of cards are available in this test


🎲 Acquiring Fate Cards


[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45617908/619f80f56076048962562ed2cb56f38b8706ec0e.png"]

Start of each run: Choose 1 of 3 random Fate Cards

Forge Master or Divine relics: Choose 1 of 3

Purchase non-Apprentice relics: Chance to trigger 3-choice draft

Roll straights or triples during dice phase: Choose 1 of 3

Max 5 Fate Cards equipped


🎯 Dice & Activation


[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45617908/f04ff855c00ff7247d1755221987076cf50ece40.png"][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45617908/d51943db8f33940e46a3772bcd62f31b075b63d9.png"][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45617908/15fb5ee91318d2bcaf4035a9e4c115b9cfdedff8.png"]

Dice are resources to activate Fate Cards (e.g., spend a “4” pip)

Start with two 6-sided dice; upgrade to max 5 via shop

In the Fate Phase (pre-combat), roll dice, then drag pips onto cards to activate them


⚔️ Fate in Combat


[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45617908/686bae4fddd50ea52a026122c4ea147693d070dc.png"]

Activated cards function like bonus relics for one battle only

Reset each round – adapt to new dice rolls!

In close matches, Fate strategy becomes the tiebreaker
[hr][/hr]
We’re excited to bring you a fresh experience and look forward to your valuable feedback!

notes.title: V0.1 First Playtest Will Conclude on July 3
notes.content:
Heroes of the Jianghu,
Thank you for embarking on this journey with us! Fighting Rogue's V0.1 playtest ends on July 3 at 24:00 (UTC+8) / 08:00 (PT). As we'll be revamping core gameplay systems, all ranked data will be reset.


Your Voice, Our Compass
Thanks a ton for your awesome suggestions! They mean the world to our dev team.


What’s Next?
Adopted Ideas: Many player proposals are already in development.

More Tests: New demos and prototypes coming soon.

Progress Updates: Follow us for real-time dev insights.



"Building the ultimate wuxia roguelike" remains our mission. With your guidance, we’ll deliver an experience worthy of the Jianghu!

notes.title: V0.1 Playtest: Community Feedback & Dev Response
notes.content:
Hey Jianghu Heroes!
Thanks for playing Rogue Wulin and sharing your feedback! We’ve compiled your top questions—let’s dive in:


Q: "Can we combo three manuals into one?"
A: Great idea! We’re exploring this as a potential faction mechanic. Stay tuned!


Q: "Will you add PvE modes like Slay the Spire? (PvE early, PvP late)"
A: PvE is on our radar, but dev resources are tight. We’re prototyping options!


Q: "Any plans for multiplayer?"
A: Likely post-PvE. Debating formats (auto-chess? 3v3?). For now, we’re polishing core gameplay.


Q: "Faction weapons need more visual distinction."
A: Agreed! Each faction already has 12 unique manuals. We’ll add faction-exclusive relics soon!


Q: "Male characters? That guy in the screenshot?"
A: YES! The fist-fighting dude in our Steam caps? He’s from a new faction—coming soon! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656215/9949dd34f859b6f558d5f1c5791c14a40465c1a5.png"]


Q: "Ultimate move animations are too rare!"
A: Update incoming! We’ll:

Show ults every round (first use)

Add an animation toggle

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656215/4e42f08418713123b267df47aa1096bdb45b8035.png"]


Q: "Dodge is OP! Buff DoT builds!"
A: Balancing is ongoing. We’re crunching data to tune DoT/sustain!


Q: "Ults don’t scale with Inner Power?"
A: Clarification:

Outer Power ≈ Physical DMG (e.g., Bai Xinyan’s ult)

Inner Power ≈ Magical DMG (e.g., Su Lianxiang’s ult)


Q: "Progression feels grindy! 1% per 30-min run?!"
A: Oops—not our intent! We’re slashing grind and smoothing unlocks ASAP.


Q: "Cheating in async PvP?"
A: Anti-cheat will launches with next playtest version. Fair matches guaranteed!


Q: "When does testing end?"
A: TBD—we’ll announce dates once optimization goals are met. More tests coming!


Q: "Full release date?"
A: We’re a small team polishing new modes/mechanics. No date yet, but we’re all-in!


Bugs & Optimizations
We’re squashing reported issues—thanks for your patience!

notes.title: Patch Notes: V0.1.4
notes.content:
Changes:[olist]
Ranked Points Optimization: Climbing ranks is now smoother in higher tiers.

Early Exit Penalty Adjustment: Improved handling of ranked points when players quit mid-match.

Low-Tier Matchmaking: Enhanced gameplay experience for entry-level ranks.
[/olist]

Fixes:[olist]
Shop Relic Preview: Fixed display bugs during pre-purchase.

Progress Loss Prevention: Resolved Steam save corruption upon abnormal game closure.

Fame System: Fame progress now persists between matches (no longer reset).

Story Unlocks: Character and faction stories can now be properly unlocked.
[/olist]
